dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a rounded taper.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical expansion on the left-mid margin relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; median intensity is consistent with a sub-adult or near-mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, low-frequency distribution of faint grey patches primarily localized toward the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; tonal transitions between lighter and slightly darker grey regions lack sharp borders.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, discrete white circular spots visible on the left lateral-dorsal plane, anterior to the mid-section.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Blowhole visible as a high-contrast circular indentation on the anterior dorsal surface; longitudinal dorsal ridge creates a distinct topological elevation casting a shadow to the left.
